question: Approve the release-acceptance design (issue #571) for implementation? Seven Captain decisions with recommendations; decisions 1 (environment and credentials slot) and 3 (package script vs a Spacedock-side refusal) change the shape most.

artifacts.summary: kc-dev-flow-2: one acceptance task per release opened from kc-journey-progress's existing 'pending delivery acceptance' label; a fresh walker; a release-acceptance/v1 report; defect routing (one owner -> that task, no story -> bug task, none or several owners -> review-release, signal 3); release_review.py check run by FO before the first implementation dispatch and by the worker as a backstop (spacedock dispatch build has no precondition input). kc-journey-map: an accept-release mode printing a release-walk/v1 list and turning the report into proposed map edits. Two producer-owned schemas, no shared code. R3 and R4 walks as fixtures.
